example.title: Ira E. Lloyd Stock Farm, silo

brief: Tall monolithic poured-concrete silo, about 14 ft across and 44 ft high, its surface banded by the horizontal lift lines of the slip forms and stained tan-gray; open top with no roof, and a narrow concrete chute enclosure running up one side. Stands roofless in a pasture of fence posts and board cattle pens. (Poured rather than stave: builder should hide the stave joints/hoops of the nearest type.)
